page.overview:
Who is Kahraman Reis?

Kahraman Reis was raised by his mother and father, with the latter becoming addicted to Semuta after the former's death.

Reis was approached by the Prisoner in Harko Village. He told them that he could provide them with fuel, as well as vehicle schematics and tools and packs for repair. He warned them that Arrakis was not a paradise like Chusuk and that ever day there was a battle, with Harko Village in particular driving people to do terrible things they never thought themselves capable of doing. He also told them that Einar Maia had told asked him about a jammed pneumatic stamp three times in the last week.
